investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin and Ethereum undervalue custody/insurance premiums post-Binance hack; expect institutional demand to shift toward on-chain self-custody and staking yields despite fee compression.
supporting_signals: BBC + CNBC: $6.3B Binance hack attributed to North Korea; custody concerns at peak
CoinDesk: institutions embracing staking despite shrinking yields; Uber tokenization pilot signals diversified custody demand
Chainalysis cybersecurity incident (Cointelegraph) amplifies chain security perception
investment_theses.counter_view: Exchange convenience and regulatory clarity (MAS Singapore, Hong Kong) may reassert; insurance costs deter retail; staking yield compression accelerates outflow.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC via spot ETF or 3-month perps; Long ETH staking via Lido LDO token or direct protocol ETH staking yield; Hedge with long DXY (risk-off USD strength in custody squeeze)

investment_theses.thesis: Crypto spending on 2026 midterms ($200M+ reported) signals industry will secure favorable regulatory outcomes; expect post-election relief rally in altcoins sensitive to SEC/CFTC policy (NEAR, HYPE, XRP proxies).
supporting_signals: CNBC: crypto industry $200M+ into 2026 midterms; $637M total super PAC spend creates obfuscation but pro-crypto groups outspend opposition
2024 crypto lobbying showed mixed ROI; 2026 reflects increased industry maturity and capital
Hyperliquid (HYPE) trending on crypto feeds; decentralized exchange narrative benefits from regulatory clarity
investment_theses.counter_view: Election outcomes (Trump sweep vs. split Congress) may not pivot policy as expected; SEC enforcement (e.g., Ripple XRP ruling) constrains altcoin upside regardless of lobbying; regulatory capture remains incomplete.
investment_theses.expression: Long NEAR Protocol (L1 gaming/defi bifurcation play); Long Hyperliquid token (HYPE) leveraged via perps; Pair trade: long crypto-friendly policy proxy vs. short broad Nasdaq tech (QQQ short hedge for rate/hyperscaler disappointment)

investment_theses.thesis: Trump energy cost pledges unmet; gasoline remains elevated; oil/energy sector outperforms cyclicals into 2026 midterms as inflation narrative persists; DXY weakness supports commodity rally.

Midterm spending ($637M) partly flows to energy-adjacent Super PACs; geopolitical risk (Ukraine Patriot sales, Russia tensions) supports oil floor
Fed cutting rates or holding supports DXY compression, commodity carry trades
investment_theses.counter_view: Recession fears and demand destruction (hyperscaler tech slowdown narrative) push oil lower; OPEC+ quotas constrain price; summer driving season demand disappoints.
investment_theses.expression: Long crude (CL=F futures, 30-60 day roll); Long XLE (Energy Select Sector ETF); Short SPY via put spreads (tech recession hedge); Pair: long USO (oil ETF) vs. short QQQ (tech rotation)

investment_theses.thesis: AI-driven security incidents (Chainalysis hack, ChatGPT account takeovers, malware using LLMs per Hacker News) signal rising cyber insurance and zero-trust infrastructure demand; traditional cybersecurity (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto PANW) and encrypted comm tools (Signal forks, Molly vulnerability) rally.
supporting_signals: Hacker News trending: 'We Took over ChatGPT Accounts' (score 218); Chainalysis hit by breach (Cointelegraph); Molly Signal fork unpatched (Hacker News, score 200)
CNBC: humans still doing work behind AI agents (Dazzle, Duckbill, Wajo) = hybrid human-AI risk surface; malware ranks victims by LLM scoring (Hacker News, score 122)
Binance + CoinDesk security narrative compounds institutional zero-trust adoption
investment_theses.counter_view: Open-source security model (Signal, Molly) may remain unfunded; enterprise slow to patch; cyber insurance premiums compress if loss ratios remain low; regulatory mandates lag.
investment_theses.expression: Long ZS (Zscaler) or CRWD (CrowdStrike) via call spreads; Long encrypted comms via Wickr or Threema proxy plays (illiquid); Pair: long cyber ETF (CYBR) vs. short consumer tech (GOOGL, META calls short)

investment_theses.thesis: Automaker 3D printing adoption (Rivian, Ford, GM per CNBC) reduces capex and accelerates EV ramp; but hyperscaler disappointments (Anthropic Nasdaq headwinds) and tech recession narrative suppress valuations; RIVN and F likely underpriced on structural margin expansion vs. traded-off on sector rotation.
